resources.counting_method: Each LUT primitive is counted once before packing; LUT RAM and SRL use their architectural LUT storage requirements. Packing may combine compatible logic LUTs or insert routing LUTs. A placed design supplies physical_lut_sites_after_placement.

physical_resources.counting_method: One physical LUT position is the common site and letter of its 5LUT and 6LUT BELs. Positions containing RAM or SRL are assigned to that storage category; all other positions are logic. The three categories are disjoint.

logical_lut_mapping.method: Compare each ordinary LUT INIT and original logical input set, match all logical input and output nets by network aliases, allow physical input permutations and O6/O5 output renaming, check common inputs of shared logic LUT positions and unique BEL assignment for every implementation cell.

path_summary.path_method: Connected bit graph from clocked storage to synchronous data/control inputs. Each LUT output follows its INIT truth table after binding constants and repeated signals; unknown truth tables retain all possible dependencies. CARRY4 dependencies follow carry direction, and asynchronous memory outputs depend on read addresses. DSP register parameters define clocked boundaries. Arithmetic between an input port and an internal register, between internal registers, or between an internal register and an output port contributes one DSP cell for that connected segment. Direct registered outputs contribute zero arithmetic cells. The identified ONE48 A:B/C ALU mode preserves low-to-high carry direction for P and PCOUT; all other DSP dependencies remain conservative, including the A:B ALU bypass. Counts describe structural depth; primitive and routing delays require device timing analysis.
